    AI Overview
    The 2026 NYC Easter Parade and Bonnet Festival takes place on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, featuring a festive, non-traditional stroll along Fifth Avenue from 49th to 57th Streets. Running from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., the free event showcases elaborate, handmade hats and, New York Post reports, vibrant costumes, with the New York Times noting the best viewing is near St. Patrick's Cathedral. 
    Key Details for the NYC Easter Parade: 
    • Location: Fifth Avenue, from 49th Street to 57th Street, Manhattan.
    • Date & Time: Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
    • What it is: A "fashion promenade" with no set floats or marching bands, focused on creative, often extravagant hats and costumes.
    • Best View: The area around St. Patrick's Cathedral.
    • Participation: The event is free and open to the public to walk or watch.
    • History: The tradition dates back to the 1870s. 
    Note: The 2026 parade saw participants in colorful, creative outfits despite overcast skies.

    Where is the St. Patty's parade in NYC?
    The parade is held annually on March 17th at precisely 11:00 AM in honor of St. Patrick, the Patron Saint of Ireland and of the Archdiocese of New York. The parade route goes up Fifth Avenue beginning at East 44th Street and ending at East 79th Street.
